entries.zh: Python 同步 Web 应用和服务器之间的标准接口（缩写，W 开头）

examples.en: Our Django app runs behind Gunicorn, which talks to it through WSGI.
examples.zh: 我们的 Django 应用跑在 Gunicorn 后面，Gunicorn 通过 WSGI 和它通信。

examples.en: WSGI is synchronous by design, so each request ties up a worker until the response is done.
examples.zh: WSGI 天生是同步的，所以每个请求会占住一个 worker，直到响应结束。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Gunicorn 这类服务器是怎么调用你的 Flask 或 Django 应用的？
situation.en: Through WSGI, a standard interface: the server calls the application with the request environment and gets the response back.

entries.note: 全称 Web Server Gateway Interface。常读成一个词 “whiz-ghee”，也有人逐字母读。

entries.zh: Python 异步 Web 应用和服务器之间的标准接口（缩写，A 开头）

examples.en: FastAPI is built on ASGI, so it can handle WebSockets and long-lived connections natively.
examples.zh: FastAPI 构建在 ASGI 之上，所以原生支持 WebSocket 和长连接。

examples.en: We moved to ASGI so the handlers could await downstream calls instead of blocking a worker.
examples.zh: 我们迁到了 ASGI，这样处理函数可以 await 下游调用，而不是堵住一个 worker。

situation.zh: 面试官问：FastAPI 为什么要用 Uvicorn 来跑，而不能直接用 Gunicorn 的同步 worker？
situation.en: Because FastAPI is an ASGI application, so it needs an ASGI server like Uvicorn that runs an event loop.

entries.note: 全称 Asynchronous Server Gateway Interface，可以看成前一条的异步版。

entries.zh: 工作进程

examples.en: With sync workers, each worker process handles one request at a time, so slow requests pile up.
examples.zh: 用同步 worker 时，每个工作进程一次只处理一个请求，所以慢请求会堆积起来。

examples.en: We restart each worker process after a thousand requests to keep slow memory leaks under control.
examples.zh: 我们让每个工作进程处理一千个请求后重启，把缓慢的内存泄漏控制住。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个 Python Web 服务怎么用上机器的多个核？
situation.en: We run several worker processes behind the same port. Each worker process has its own interpreter and its own GIL.

entries.zh: 请求-响应周期

examples.en: Sending the email inside the request-response cycle made the signup endpoint painfully slow.
examples.zh: 在请求-响应周期里发邮件，让注册接口慢得受不了。

examples.en: Anything that takes more than a second shouldn't happen in the request-response cycle.
examples.zh: 耗时超过一秒的事情都不应该放在请求-响应周期里做。

situation.zh: 面试官问：生成报表要三十秒，用户点了按钮之后你怎么处理？
situation.en: I wouldn't do it in the request-response cycle. I'd queue a background job and return right away with a job ID.

entries.zh: 对查询集求值（这时才真正查数据库）

examples.en: Chaining filters is free; nothing hits the database until you evaluate the queryset.
examples.zh: 链式加过滤条件没有任何开销；直到对查询集求值，才会真正访问数据库。

examples.en: Calling len() evaluates the queryset and loads every row, so use count() instead.
examples.zh: 调用 len() 会对查询集求值并把每一行都加载进来，所以应该改用 count()。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Django 里写了 User.objects.filter(...)，这一行执行时会发 SQL 吗？
situation.en: No. Querysets are lazy, so the SQL only runs when you evaluate the queryset, for example by iterating over it.

entries.note: Django 的 QuerySet 是惰性的（lazy）：迭代、len()、list()、bool() 都会触发求值。

entries.zh: 数据库表结构迁移（s 开头）

examples.en: Every model change goes through a schema migration that's reviewed like any other code.
examples.zh: 每次模型改动都要走一次表结构迁移，并且像其他代码一样经过评审。

examples.en: That schema migration locked the table for minutes, so now we run big ones off-peak.
examples.zh: 那次表结构迁移把表锁了好几分钟，所以现在大的迁移我们都放在低峰期跑。

situation.zh: 面试官问：给线上的表加一个字段，你们的流程是什么？
situation.en: We generate a schema migration with makemigrations, review the SQL, and apply it during the deploy before the new code starts.

entries.zh: 校验请求体

examples.en: FastAPI validates the request body against the Pydantic model before our handler even runs.
examples.zh: FastAPI 会在我们的处理函数运行之前，先按 Pydantic 模型校验请求体。

examples.en: We validate the request body at the edge, so the rest of the code can trust its input.
examples.zh: 我们在入口处校验请求体，这样后面的代码可以放心使用输入。

situation.zh: 面试官问：客户端传来的 JSON 里有个字段类型不对，FastAPI 里你需要手写判断吗？
situation.en: No. FastAPI validates the request body against the Pydantic model and returns a 422 with the details automatically.

entries.zh: 序列化器（把模型对象和 JSON 互相转换的那一层）

examples.en: The serializer decides which model fields are exposed in the API response.
examples.zh: 由序列化器决定模型的哪些字段会暴露在接口响应里。

examples.en: We use one serializer for reads and a stricter one for writes.
examples.zh: 读操作我们用一个序列化器，写操作用另一个更严格的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Django REST framework 里，模型对象是怎么变成 JSON、又是在哪里校验输入的？
situation.en: Through a serializer. It converts model instances to JSON and also validates incoming data before we save it.

entries.zh: 注入一个数据库会话

examples.en: We inject a database session into each endpoint with Depends, and it's closed when the request finishes.
examples.zh: 我们用 Depends 给每个接口注入一个数据库会话，请求结束时它会被关闭。

examples.en: Because we inject the database session, tests can override it with one that points at a test database.
examples.zh: 因为数据库会话是注入进来的，测试可以把它替换成指向测试库的会话。

situation.zh: 面试官问：FastAPI 里每个请求用到的数据库连接是怎么拿到、又怎么保证释放的？
situation.en: We inject a database session through a dependency that yields it, so the cleanup code always runs once the request is done.

entries.note: FastAPI 的依赖用 Depends 声明；测试里用 app.dependency_overrides 替换。

entries.zh: 虚拟环境

examples.en: Each project gets its own virtual environment, so their dependencies never clash.
examples.zh: 每个项目有自己的虚拟环境，所以它们的依赖不会打架。

examples.en: I forgot to activate the virtual environment and installed everything into the system Python.
examples.zh: 我忘了激活虚拟环境，把所有东西都装进了系统 Python。

situation.zh: 面试官问：两个项目依赖同一个库的不同版本，在一台机器上怎么共存？
situation.en: Give each project its own virtual environment, so each one has an isolated set of installed packages.

entries.note: 口语里常直接说 a venv。

entries.zh: 把依赖固定到确切版本（p 开头的动词）

examples.en: We pin the dependencies to exact versions so every build installs the same thing.
examples.zh: 我们把依赖固定到确切版本，这样每次构建装的东西都一样。

examples.en: Nobody had pinned the dependencies, so a new release of a library broke production overnight.
examples.zh: 没人把依赖版本固定下来，结果某个库发了新版，一夜之间把线上搞挂了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：代码没改，上周还正常的镜像今天重新构建却出了问题，怎么避免？
situation.en: Pin the dependencies, including the indirect ones, in a lock file, so a build never picks up a new release by accident.

entries.zh: 依赖解析器（算出一组互相兼容的版本的那个组件）

examples.en: The dependency resolver couldn't find versions of the two libraries that work together.
examples.zh: 依赖解析器找不到能让这两个库一起工作的版本组合。

examples.en: We switched to uv mostly because its dependency resolver is so much faster than pip's.
examples.zh: 我们换成 uv 主要是因为它的依赖解析器比 pip 的快太多了。

situation.zh: 同事问：pip install 为什么卡了半天，最后报版本冲突？
situation.en: The dependency resolver was backtracking through versions and couldn't find a set that satisfies every constraint.

entries.zh: 构建 wheel 包（Python 的预构建分发格式）

examples.en: CI builds a wheel for each platform, so users don't need a compiler to install it.
examples.zh: CI 会为每个平台构建 wheel 包，这样用户安装时不需要编译器。

examples.en: We build a wheel once and install that same file in staging and production.
examples.zh: 我们只构建一次 wheel 包，然后在预发和生产环境安装同一个文件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们内部的 Python 库是怎么分发给其他团队的？
situation.en: We build a wheel in CI and publish it to our private package index, and other teams install it with pip.

entries.note: wheel 是预构建的分发格式（.whl）；另一种是 source distribution（sdist），安装时可能需要编译。

entries.zh: 可编辑安装（改了源码立刻生效，不用重装）

examples.en: I use an editable install during development, so code changes show up without reinstalling the package.
examples.zh: 开发时我用可编辑安装，这样改了代码不用重装包就能生效。

examples.en: With an editable install, the tests import the code straight from the source tree.
examples.zh: 用可编辑安装的话，测试直接从源码目录导入代码。

situation.zh: 同事问：我在本地改了这个库的代码，为什么另一个项目里跑的还是旧版本？
situation.en: You probably installed a regular copy. Do an editable install with pip install -e, and your changes will be picked up.

entries.zh: 双下划线方法（魔术方法的口头说法，d 开头）

examples.en: We implemented the __eq__ and __hash__ dunder methods so the objects can be used as dict keys.
examples.zh: 我们实现了 __eq__ 和 __hash__ 这两个双下划线方法，这样对象就能当字典的键用。

examples.en: Dunder methods like __len__ and __getitem__ let your class work with built-in functions and syntax.
examples.zh: 像 __len__ 和 __getitem__ 这样的双下划线方法，能让你的类配合内置函数和语法使用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么让自己写的类支持 len()、下标访问和 == 比较？
situation.en: By implementing the matching dunder methods: __len__, __getitem__ and __eq__.

entries.note: dunder 是 double underscore 的缩略，__init__ 读作 “dunder init”。也叫 magic method 或 special method。

entries.zh: 元类

examples.en: The ORM uses a metaclass to turn the fields you declare into database columns.
examples.zh: 这个 ORM 用元类把你声明的字段变成数据库的列。

examples.en: I've only needed a metaclass once; a class decorator or __init_subclass__ is usually enough.
examples.zh: 我只有一次真的需要元类；通常用类装饰器或 __init_subclass__ 就够了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Python 里类本身也是对象，那创建类的又是什么？
situation.en: A metaclass. By default it's type, and you can write your own metaclass to customize how classes are created.

entries.zh: 方法解析顺序

examples.en: With multiple inheritance, the method resolution order decides which parent's method gets called first.
examples.zh: 多继承时，方法解析顺序决定先调用哪个父类的方法。

examples.en: super() follows the method resolution order, so it doesn't always call the direct parent.
examples.zh: super() 是按方法解析顺序走的，所以调用的不一定是直接父类。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个类继承了两个父类，两个父类都有同名方法，调用的是哪个？
situation.en: Python follows the method resolution order, which is computed with C3 linearization. You can inspect it through the __mro__ attribute.

entries.zh: 抽象基类

examples.en: We defined an abstract base class for storage backends, with S3 and local disk as implementations.
examples.zh: 我们为存储后端定义了一个抽象基类，S3 和本地磁盘是它的两个实现。

examples.en: You can't instantiate an abstract base class until every abstract method has been overridden.
examples.zh: 抽象基类的所有抽象方法都被重写之前，是不能实例化的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Python 里想强制子类必须实现某些方法，怎么做？
situation.en: Define an abstract base class with abc.ABC and mark the methods with @abstractmethod. A subclass that skips one can't be instantiated.

entries.note: 缩写 ABC。不要求继承、只按“长得像”来约束时，用 typing.Protocol（structural subtyping）。

entries.zh: 打猴子补丁（在运行时替换别人的函数或属性，动词）

examples.en: The test monkey-patches time.time so we can control the clock.
examples.zh: 这个测试用猴子补丁替换了 time.time，这样我们就能控制时钟。

examples.en: We had to monkey-patch the library as a stopgap until the upstream fix was released.
examples.zh: 在上游的修复发布之前，我们只能先给这个库打猴子补丁顶一下。

situation.zh: 同事问：第三方库里有个 bug，我们又不想 fork，能不能先临时绕过去？
situation.en: We could monkey-patch that one function at startup, but let's add a comment and remove it once the fix is released.

entries.note: 名词是 monkey patching。pytest 里对应的 fixture 叫 monkeypatch。

entries.zh: 任务队列（跑后台任务用的，t 开头）

examples.en: We push slow work like sending emails onto a task queue and return to the user immediately.
examples.zh: 我们把发邮件这类慢活丢到任务队列里，然后立刻给用户返回。

examples.en: Celery is the task queue we use, with Redis as the broker.
examples.zh: 我们用的任务队列是 Celery，用 Redis 做 broker。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户上传视频后要转码好几分钟，这个流程你怎么设计？
situation.en: The API just saves the file and puts a job on a task queue. A separate worker picks it up and does the transcoding.

entries.zh: 把一个任务放进队列（e 开头的动词）

examples.en: The view enqueues a task and returns a 202, and the worker does the actual processing.
examples.zh: 视图把一个任务放进队列并返回 202，真正的处理由 worker 来做。

examples.en: We only enqueue the task after the transaction commits, otherwise the worker may not find the row.
examples.zh: 我们等事务提交之后才把任务放进队列，否则 worker 可能查不到那行数据。

situation.zh: 同事问：Celery 的 worker 报错说找不到刚创建的订单，可数据库里明明有，怎么回事？
situation.en: We enqueue the task before the transaction commits. Let's use transaction.on_commit so the worker only sees committed data.

entries.note: enqueue 读 /ɪnˈkjuː/。Celery 里对应 task.delay() 或 apply_async()。

entries.zh: 对代码做性能剖析（动词短语，p 开头）

examples.en: Before optimizing anything, I profiled the code and found that most of the time was JSON serialization.
examples.zh: 在优化之前，我先对代码做了性能剖析，发现大部分时间花在 JSON 序列化上。

examples.en: We profile the code in production with py-spy, because it doesn't need a restart.
examples.zh: 我们在生产环境用 py-spy 对代码做性能剖析，因为它不需要重启服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个接口很慢，你怎么确定慢在哪里，而不是凭感觉猜？
situation.en: I'd profile the code first, with cProfile locally or py-spy in production, and look at where the time actually goes.

entries.zh: C 扩展（用 C 写的 Python 模块）

examples.en: The hot loop was rewritten as a C extension, which made it about fifty times faster.
examples.zh: 那个热点循环被改写成了 C 扩展，速度快了大约五十倍。

examples.en: Installing it failed because the C extension had no prebuilt wheel for our platform.
examples.zh: 安装失败了，因为这个 C 扩展没有适用于我们平台的预构建 wheel。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Python 这么慢，NumPy 这类库为什么能这么快？
situation.en: Because the heavy lifting happens in C extensions: the loops run in compiled code, not in the interpreter.

entries.zh: 自由线程构建版（去掉了 GIL 的 CPython）

examples.en: On the free-threaded build, threads can finally run Python code in parallel on multiple cores.
examples.zh: 在自由线程构建版上，线程终于可以在多个核上并行执行 Python 代码了。

examples.en: We're not using the free-threaded build yet, because some of our C extensions don't support it.
examples.zh: 我们还没用自由线程构建版，因为有些 C 扩展还不支持它。

situation.zh: 面试官问：听说新版 Python 可以去掉 GIL 了，你了解吗？
situation.en: Yes. Since 3.13 there's an optional free-threaded build without the GIL, but the default build still has it.

entries.note: 来自 PEP 703：3.13 起作为实验特性提供，3.14 起成为官方支持的可选构建；默认构建仍然带 GIL。
